logo.use: header (~76px) on every scene except the hook; big badge (~540px) on the end card

format: vertical 1080x1920, 30 fps; captions: Roman Hindi (Inter 800, 44px) + English line (Inter 500, 28px, tan), bottom of box at y=1500

voice.engine: edge-tts on GitHub Actions (probe/tts_ck.py, lines in probe/ck_lines.json)

mix.rule: voice must stay clearly on top: Hassan found the first mix's background too loud (Nov 15, 2026)

youtube_policy: Binding (Nov 20, 2026). Each Short is a new story with its own script, scenes and hook; never reuse an earlier video's scenes or wording.
No match footage, broadcast clips, photos or logos (reused content); players only as stylised characters; no photorealistic AI likenesses or voice clones of real players.
Max 1 Short per day + the Sunday film; never upload the same video twice.
Titles/thumbnails must match the story; no keyword lists in descriptions (tags field only, max 15).
